# Hooks, Part W2: run report (generated by src/hooks_w2_report.py)

PD islands (100, 64), mN = 1, 40 runs, compared at generation 1,000; fission-fusion 32 x 100 merged at 200, horizon 600, 20 runs; union game (30, 16), mN = 1, horizon 1,000, 40 runs.  Rows prefixed `W:` are Part W's stored rows (same founders, fills and seeds).  Means with bootstrap or Wilson 95% intervals.  Every number is an eps = 0 lottery statistic at finite (N, I, horizon).

- ff-lineage-max vs Part W ff-maximal: 20 of 20 runs identical (island states / labels and counters)
